props.eyebrow: Event music at a Downtown Denver hotel
props.title: Hilton Denver City Center
props.lede: Hilton Denver City Center is on California Street, a short walk from the Colorado Convention Center, with 613 guest rooms and three ballrooms.

headingText.html: It’s a busy conference and company-meeting hotel, and it hosts weddings too, with its own wedding planning team.

props.title: Live music in each Hilton Denver City Center event space
props.lede: Here’s the act we’d pick for each space. Press play to hear it over the photo.

spaces.name: Colorado Ballroom
spaces.facts: The Colorado Ballroom is the hotel’s biggest, for events of up to about 1,200 guests, and it divides into eight sections.
spaces.why: A six-piece band playing 90s and 2000s R&B and hip-hop, for when you want everyone dancing.

spaces.name: Denver Ballroom
spaces.facts: The Denver Ballroom is about 5,900 sq ft, for banquets of up to 450. It divides into six salons, and it opens onto a pre-function space of about 3,200 sq ft.
spaces.why: Stevie Wonder, Aretha Franklin and Motown, for a party where people dance.
spaces.alt: The Denver Ballroom set with black cocktail tables on a patterned carpet.

spaces.name: Penrose Ballroom
spaces.facts: The Penrose Ballroom is about 2,800 sq ft, for dinners of up to about 200 and receptions of up to 240, across from Prospect’s Urban Kitchen and Bar.
spaces.why: Upright bass and guitar, at a volume nobody has to raise their voice over.
spaces.alt: The Penrose Ballroom set with round tables in dark linens.

spaces.name: Outdoor plaza
spaces.facts: The hotel has an outdoor plaza that it uses for weddings and receptions.
spaces.why: Flamenco and rumba on Spanish guitar, for a cocktail hour or a dinner.
spaces.alt: White chairs with gold sashes set for a ceremony on the tree-lined outdoor plaza.

props.html: Questions to ask the Hilton Denver City Center events team

items.html: Which spaces have an end time for amplified music, and when is it?
Does the hotel’s AV team need to connect or run the band’s sound, and is there a fee for that?
Where do vendors load in, and when can the band set up?
Is there power near where the band will play?
What wording do you need on the certificate of insurance?

props.html: Forward this list to the events team, or send us the answers and we’ll plan around them.
Questions about music at Hilton Denver City Center

items.q: Can we bring our own band to an event at Hilton Denver City Center?
items.a: Hotels like Hilton Denver City Center generally let you book your own entertainment, within their rules on insurance, load-in and sound. Your event manager can confirm them for your date, and we send a certificate of insurance with every booking.

items.q: Does the band need the hotel’s AV team?
items.a: Our acts bring their own sound system, sized to the space. The hotel’s AV team can add anything beyond that, and we’ll work out the details with your event manager.

items.q: Can one act play the ceremony, the cocktail hour and the reception?
items.a: Yes. The same act can move with you from The outdoor plaza to The Denver Ballroom, and one booking covers all of it.

items.q: How much does live music add to an event at Hilton Denver City Center?
items.a: It depends on the size of the act and how much of the day it covers. Our pricing page has what live music costs in the Colorado market, and we’ll send a quote for your date.
